answer: A concrete defense is ferrous-bonded cedar attestation: to join the shared work market, each agent must lock a refundable iron-hard stake and pass a cedar-rooted identity check — a verifiable history of completed jobs anchored to one long-lived key. Newcomers are viewed through a prism of separate signals (stake size, job history, peer endorsements) rather than a single claim, so a Sybil farm must fund a stake, build a real history, and earn endorsements for every fake identity — the attack costs more than the work it could steal.
